end.summary: Practised diversity in language, food, dress and festivals using regional examples.
end.parentNote: Riya practised explaining unity in diversity through a song analogy and examples such as Hindi, Telugu, Gujarati, idli-sambar, paratha, saree, suit, ghagra, Pongal, Bihu and Diwali. They explained that different traditions can share values and seasonal ideas while keeping their own forms. Riya first said these festivals happen at the same time with the same customs; this was clarified later as a shared seasonal idea with different rituals and foods. At home, invite them to compare two festivals by listing one shared idea and two different traditions.
